submissions.shortDescription: 15th-century Jain and Shiva temples amidst dense dry deciduous forest.
submissions.detailedDescription: The ancient Polo forest is spread over 400 square kilometers near Vijayanagar. It was established around the 10th century by the Parihar kings of Idar and subsequently conquered by the Rathod Rajputs. The site features ruins of intricately carved 15th century Jain and Shiva shrines along the Harnav River.

submissions.shortDescription: One of the most prominent cities of the ancient Indus Valley Civilization with world oldest tidal dockyard.
submissions.detailedDescription: Discovered in 1954, Lothal holds the world oldest known port basin connecting the city to an ancient course of the Sabarmati river. Features bead-making factory and drainage system.
travelTips: Visit the ASI Archaeological Museum on site
